page.overview:
Who is Amdir?

Amdír, also known as Malgalad, was an Elf of Doriath, the father of Amroth and King of Lothlórien.

Amdír was a Sindar Elf from Doriath. Amdír was born in Doriath during the Years of the Trees. Little is known about his early life. However, he joined Thingol's army and fought in the First Battle of Beleriand against Morgoth. Later, he defended Doriath during the Assault on Doriath. He then joined the company of Beleg and Mablung and fought in the Nírnaeth Arnoediad. He survived the Battle in the Thousand Caves against the Dwarves. He later fought in the Battle of Sarn Athrad. He fought in the Second Kinslaying following the attack on Doriath by the Sons of Fëanor. But the Elves of Doriath lost the battle. And Amdír fled to the Mouths of Sirion. The sons of Fëanor attacked the Mouths of Sirion, and Amdír managed to survive the Third Kinslaying as well. He then fought in the War of Wrath. But he refused to go to Valinor and remained in Middle-earth. Then he migrated east into Eriador. He took over the realm of Lórinand (later Lórien) from the Silvan Elves, south of where Oropher established the Woodland Realm among the Silvan Elves of Mirkwood. He later fought in Siege of Eregion, First Siege of Imladris and Battle of the Gwathló.

Amdír and Oropher joined Gil-galad's forces when he crossed the Misty Mountains in the War of the Last Alliance. He was killed leading a precipitous charge in the Battle of Dagorlad alongside most of those who followed him. His son Amroth succeeded him as King of Lórien.
